apps.name: Alien Shooter World (Paid App)
apps.localizedDescription:
The updated version of the legendary Alien Shooter is already available on all iOS devices!

Now you can save the world from monsters together with your friends in co-op mode: invite friends to a squad or find new allies using auto-selection.



Thanks to the updated weapon system, you can choose equipment based on your playstyle. Combine different types of weapons or armor in one set, pick up perks for your needs, change equipment depending on the task.

More than 20 arenas with unique bosses, new combat mechanics, special enemies and champions. Fulfill contracts and explore the roadmap to get better weapons and discover new activities.

What awaits you inside?

- Hours of gameplay: three main story maps, a lot of additional mission
